name: Resid hydrocracking (ebullated and slurry bed)
principle: Residue is hydrocracked at high pressure in reactors that keep catalyst moving: ebullated beds fluidise supported catalyst with recycled liquid, while slurry processes disperse a very fine catalyst in the feed in bubble column reactors. Unconverted residue can be recycled, which lets slurry processes reach very high conversion.

process_steps.name: Reactors
equipment: slurry bubble column or ebullated bed reactors

performance.metric: residue conversion, EST pilot and demonstration runs

advantages: Reduces fuel oil and coke make
limitations: Very high pressure and hydrogen use
